echoParts: from the curse of the law
by becoming a curse for us
who is hanged on a tree'
verseText: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law by becoming a curse for us – for it is written, 'Cursed is everyone who is hanged on a tree.'
meaning: Sin's curse is death. Jesus redeemed us (paid the price to rescue us) from sin's dreadful curse by suffering the curse of death in our place on the cross.
